number_of_fractions.evidence: Peptide mixtures (~150 µg) were fractionated employing the high-pH reversed-phase C18 (HpH) peptide fractionation method, using a ZORBAX 300 Extend-C18 2.1 × 150 mm, 3.5 µm column on a 1260 HPLC system (Agilent, CA, USA). Buffer A (5 mM ammonium formate) and Buffer B (5 mM ammonium formate with 90% acetonitrile in water) were used for the fractionation at a flow rate of 0.3 ml/min, yielding up to 20 fractions.
